description: Look for the default AI-generated design look in a live page's markup and CSS: purple-to-blue gradients, gradient text, a default font stack, pill buttons with arrows, uppercase eyebrow labels, emoji headings, glassmorphism, glow blobs, equal card grids, stock marketing phrases and placeholder copy. Returns weighted signals and a 0 to 100 score. Signals, not proof.
